While the requirement states not to expose any action when no track is playing, it doesn't specifically mention initial conditions. Adjusting the default to false seems to align better with ensuring the glyph appears correctly.

It seems like a straightforward patch, and I'll make sure to include a comment to clarify this behavior for future reference. It’s essential to ensure clarity about initial conditions and visibility, so this change should help with that!
